create_MLP: create a simple multi-layer perceptron with configurable input, hidden, output dimensions and number of layers
build_EarlyStopping: build an early stopping callback that halts training when validation loss stops improving after a patience threshold
test_bip_accuracy: test the bipartite top-k accuracy computation for matching predictions to targets
run_box_iou: run generalized box IoU computation for evaluating bounding box overlap between two sets of boxes
summarize_remove_padding: summarize the function that strips trailing zero padding from integer sequences and returns the unpadded sequence with pad length
